text:
maya: Quick late-night poll — pairing editors + snacks. Vote with numbers/letters: 
1️⃣ VSCode  2️⃣ Neovim  3️⃣ IntelliJ  4️⃣ Emacs
A 🍟 Chips  B 🍎 Fruit  C 🥪 Sandwich  D 🍜 Ramen
Drop your picks like ‘2 + D’ or emoji. I will tally in an hour!

devin: 2 + D — Neovim + ramen, obviously.

ryan_k: 1 + C — VSCode and sandwich for the win. Too tired for vim dark arts.

samir: 2 + D — neovim + ramen. Add egg. :yum: 

li: 3 + B — IntelliJ when I’m debugging backend stuff, fruit otherwise.

maya: current quick tally: Neovim 2, VSCode 1, IntelliJ 1; ramen 2, sandwich 1, fruit 1, chips 0

devin: can we make ramen the official midnight snack budget line item? :rofl:

ryan_k: @devin only if it comes with instant coffee sponsorship.

samir: @ryan_k we should lobby people ops. free ramen = happy engineers. :raised_hands:

li: Also quick note — if anyone wants to actually cook, there’s a tiny induction burner in kitchenette. Don’t burn anything.

ops-bot: Poll closed by maya (1h). Final tally: Neovim 2, VSCode 1, IntelliJ 1; Ramen 2, Sandwich 1, Fruit 1, Chips 0.

maya: Nice! Looks like Neovim + Ramen is the late-night combo. Thanks for voting — will put a ramen run sign-up in #lunch-plans for anyone who wants to join later.

devin: :thumbsup:

ryan_k: Nominate ramen for next week’s snack fund. I’ll bring soy sauce packets.

samir: emoji reaction spree :ramen: :ramen: :ramen:

li: staying healthy crew: hydrate pls.
